rationale_md: Argentina enters this Group J encounter as overwhelming favorites, with a 350-point Elo rating advantage that reflects the gulf in quality between the two-time world champions and Algeria's inconsistent international form. The model assigns La Albiceleste nearly an 80% chance of victory, a projection supported by their recent tournament pedigree and depth of talent across all positions. Algeria faces an uphill battle to extract even a point from this fixture, needing a near-perfect defensive performance and clinical finishing on the rare chances they're likely to create.
